# Dioptron

> Specification-stage sovereign web runtime with agent co-tenancy.

Dioptron defines a local web substrate where operator and AI agents are peer tenants on one capability surface for browsing, ingesting, querying, and acting on the web. No Rust implementation crates have landed yet.

## Surface

The current surface is the design corpus: requirements, topology, tenancy, decisions, training-data taxonomy, lexicon, and open questions.

## Architecture

Structured LLM corpus:
- [_llm/architecture.toml](_llm/architecture.toml): bands, layers, tenancy plane, and planned implementation surface
- [_llm/current_state.toml](_llm/current_state.toml): phase, recent decisions, and open threads
- [_llm/decisions.toml](_llm/decisions.toml): accepted web-runtime decisions
- [_llm/glossary.toml](_llm/glossary.toml): dioptron vocabulary

## Agent Entry Points

- [README.md](README.md): overview and documentation map
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): locked decisions and repo conventions
- [docs/design/topology.md](docs/design/topology.md): 3-band, 11-layer topology
- [docs/design/tenancy.md](docs/design/tenancy.md): peer tenant model
- [docs/design/decisions.md](docs/design/decisions.md): technical decisions
